title: ML Training & Feature Store
summary: A machine-learning platform has to compute features the same way twice: in bulk over history for training, and one row at a time in milliseconds for serving. A feature store bridges the two. Pipelines write each feature once into an offline store for point-in-time-correct training sets and an online store for live lookups. Models move from training through a registry with evaluation gates into serving, and production predictions are monitored for drift.

walkthrough.title: Ingest raw data
walkthrough.text: Transactions, clickstream events, and database tables arrive as batch files and streams.

walkthrough.title: Compute features once, write twice
walkthrough.text: A feature such as user_txn_count_7d is defined once. Batch and streaming jobs compute it and write timestamped history to the offline store and the latest value to the online store.

walkthrough.title: Build a point-in-time training set
walkthrough.text: For each training label, the feature store joins each feature's value as of that label's timestamp, never later. That prevents leaking the future into training.

walkthrough.title: Train and register
walkthrough.text: GPU jobs train the model. The artifact, its exact data snapshot, code version, and evaluation metrics are logged to the model registry.

walkthrough.title: Gate and deploy
walkthrough.text: A model that beats the current version on held-out data and fairness checks is promoted and rolled out to serving as a canary or shadow deployment first.

walkthrough.title: Serve with fresh features
walkthrough.text: At request time the serving layer fetches the same features from the online store in a few milliseconds and runs inference.

walkthrough.title: Monitor and retrain
walkthrough.text: Predictions, inputs, and later outcomes are logged. Drift in input distributions or falling accuracy triggers alerts and scheduled retraining.

data.label: Raw Data Sources
responsibilities: Provide the facts features are computed from.
Carry event timestamps so history can be replayed correctly.
Supply ground-truth labels, often days later (chargebacks, churn).

failureModes.mitigation: Data contracts and validation (Great Expectations) on every input.

failureModes.impact: Recent data looks like all negatives.
failureModes.mitigation: Only train on windows whose labels have matured.

data.label: Feature Pipelines
responsibilities: Computes each feature from one shared definition.
Writes history offline and latest values online.
Backfills new features over historical data.

failureModes.impact: Training/serving skew: the model sees different inputs in production.
failureModes.mitigation: One definition compiled to both engines; compare outputs continuously.
Freshness SLOs per feature with alerts; models tolerant of missing values.

data.label: Offline Feature Store

output.name: Training set
output.type: Labels joined with features as of each label time

responsibilities: Keeps full feature history for training and backtests.
Builds training sets without future leakage.
Versions datasets so any model can be reproduced.

failureModes.impact: Leakage: brilliant offline accuracy, poor production results.
failureModes.mitigation: As-of joins on event timestamp; leakage checks in CI.
Partitioning, caching of common training sets, sampling.

data.label: Online Feature Store
responsibilities: Serves the latest feature values per entity at low latency.
Handles high read throughput from serving.
Expires values that are too stale to trust.

failureModes.mitigation: Replicas, fallbacks to default values, and a simpler backup model.
Replicate hot keys; cache in the serving process.

data.label: Training Jobs
responsibilities: Trains models reproducibly from versioned data and code.
Tunes hyperparameters and evaluates on held-out data.
Records lineage: which data and code produced this model.

failureModes.impact: Cannot explain or rebuild a production model.
failureModes.mitigation: Pin data snapshots, seeds, and container images.

data.label: Model Registry & Evaluation
responsibilities: Stores every model version with metadata.
Gates promotion on metrics, fairness, and latency tests.
Enables instant rollback to the previous version.

failureModes.scenario: Offline metric improves but business metric drops
failureModes.mitigation: Online A/B tests before full promotion.

failureModes.impact: No one knows what is in production.
failureModes.mitigation: Promotion only through the registry with approvals.

data.label: Model Serving
responsibilities: Fetches online features and runs inference within the latency budget.
Runs new versions in shadow or canary before full rollout.
Logs inputs and outputs for monitoring and future training.

failureModes.mitigation: Distribution monitoring per feature; retrain triggers.

failureModes.scenario: Model and features out of sync
failureModes.impact: New model expects a feature the online store lacks.
failureModes.mitigation: Deploy feature definitions before the model that needs them; validate at load.
